# Credits {.unnumbered}

The three-day scope was chosen to fill the specific gap
between the companion boot camp and the *Biostatistics
Practicum*: the version-control craft that a student needs
within days of the first commit, but that belongs neither
in a first week nor in an infrastructure course. The topic
selection draws on Scott Chacon and Ben Straub's *Pro Git*,
Jenny Bryan's *Happy Git and GitHub for the useR*, and the
intermediate portions of the Software Carpentry
version-control lessons.

Cover artwork generated procedurally by the R script at
`images/build-cover.R`. Palette: deep slate through steel
and pale mist, anchored on a brand steel blue `#2c4a5e`
chosen to sit alongside, and one register cooler than, the
boot camp's rust. Typography: Avenir family (Apple system
font); body text in Source Serif 4.
